svg.title: Festio Juniors: setup, daily handoffs, recorded returns, gala and volunteer handover

text.tspan: Overview · Children · My classroom · Programme · More
Home · Children · Scan · My shift · More
DAY 0: Platform check-in only. FROM DAY 1: A fresh daily JP drop-off, screening and wristband check.
Review saved allergy and accommodation answers.
Confirm both today; ask for missing answers.
DAILY CHECK: Standard band for all. Allergy + accommodation needs = standard + allergy + accommodation bands (3 bands).
Every temporary departure has a recorded return
When enabled: email + SMS to designated guardian contacts.
Review status in More → Notifications. Medical details stay private.
Failed or no receipt? Review before retrying.
Late relief? Alert the lead and stay with the children until responsibility is safely transferred.
Volunteers keep every handoff safe and smooth to prevent overcrowding.
